_comment: Copy this file to approved_sources.json, then keep only the sources you want the AI re-ranking step to receive. DEFAULT-DENY: any source not listed here is never sent to the AI (it is still searchable in raw / --no-llm mode, which makes no external call). The simplest setup is "approved": "all" for each source you have reviewed -- as shown below. You do NOT need folder ids.
_optional_finer_control: Instead of "all", you can approve only specific locations by listing ids -- Google Drive folder ids, Box folder ids, or Confluence space keys. Example:  "confluence": { "approved": ["ITOPS", "HR"] }
